route: Scoped evidence revision and retention, validated on complete natural sources before learned or solver claims.

unchanged_feasibility_gate.scope: Retain existing source, dependency, control and authority admission requirements. A smaller access pilot neither replaces nor satisfies the eight-history target.

present_evidence_boundary.jama: One evidence-selected present-document residual and narrow passage-reading task; no historical exact spans or same-authority certificate. Displayed comparison can be read without graph propagation.
present_evidence_boundary.support_adapter: Annotation-conditioned exact assertion-ID lookup on explicitly supplied state; tests establish contract consistency, not natural QA, truth, provenance authenticity or novel correction semantics.

histories.purpose: Recover actual annual-report representations; preserve directly restated dependent values as competent-baseline controls. Admission is not presumed.
Recover explicitly versioned abstracts and complete papers separately; verify same observations and exact revised assertions, retaining any direct conclusion correction.
Recover complete present article and notice as a possible full-document consistency case. These URLs do not provide an observed pre-correction article and cannot fill the historical gate.

next_access_pilot.existing_bound_note: Keep the prior bounded transport envelope; an over-limit source is recorded as an access limitation. Any change needs a separately recorded pre-execution engineering amendment, not a hidden retry.
next_access_pilot.allowed_transport: Available authorized primary-source retrieval only; no sign-in, challenge bypass, fabricated alternate URL or hidden retry.
next_access_pilot.stopping_rule: Stop after these eight listed representations or earlier when remaining attempts cannot add a qualifying representation. Log every outcome and all unusable or incomplete material.
next_access_pilot.source_completeness: Bind exact retrieved representation, full extraction and version metadata. A truncated web result, selected passage pack or abstract is not the full paper. Abstracts remain separate complete bounded source documents.
next_access_pilot.historical_rule: No update removal, swapping restored numbers, reconstructed old prose or retrieval-date substitution to simulate a historical original. Version identity does not establish first public availability.

before_predictions: Freeze complete source inputs and admission decisions.
Independently certify correction target, asserting and revising authority, scope, source-present downstream dependency and unaffected control.
Retain direct correction of dependents and alternative independent support.
Freeze answer/evidence references; disclose model assistance and nonhuman status.
Separate source reading and candidate extraction from state update and assertion-ID lookup.
authority_rule: Do not silently merge a publisher with article authors. Any extension must explicitly distinguish authority to revise the publication from assertion authorship, undergo source-only review, and preserve the old-core comparison; it is not a new novelty claim.
matched_comparison: Complete-input reader, competent direct-target updates and dependency updates must receive matched evidence, proposals and scores where applicable. Keep extraction/routing failures separate. Add alternative-support semantics only when certified natural evidence requires it.
pivot_rule: If the bounded access pilot cannot provide qualifying histories, or accessible histories leave no residual outside direct correction, stop expanding the current longitudinal method claim. Consider a separately named full-document inconsistency evaluation with accessible complete documents, independently reviewed scope and a new frozen design. Do not promote the single selected passage case into a benchmark or silently convert it into temporal evaluation.

decision_table.condition: Complete historical sources cannot be recovered in the bounded pilot
decision_table.decision: Keep longitudinal method gate closed; propose an explicitly separate full-document inconsistency study only after complete present documents and independent references are available.
decision_table.forbidden_inference: Missing transport is not semantic failure or evidence of rarity.

decision_table.condition: Historical sources recovered, but every dependent assertion is already directly corrected
decision_table.decision: Use these as direct-correction controls; do not claim incremental propagation value.
decision_table.forbidden_inference: Do not hide explicit downstream corrections.

decision_table.condition: Matched reader, direct policy and dependency policy all answer correctly
decision_table.decision: No answer-level advantage established; any efficiency claim needs its own matched measurements.
decision_table.forbidden_inference: Support bookkeeping is not QA gain.

decision_table.condition: Reader fails but direct correction answers correctly, with no dependency improvement
decision_table.decision: Investigate extraction and direct revision handling; no propagation claim.
decision_table.forbidden_inference: Do not attribute direct-update benefit to graph propagation.

decision_table.condition: Dependency policy improves answers over reader and direct policy on certified nondirect dependencies
decision_table.decision: Candidate method signal only; expand to independently held-out histories, ablations and uncertainty analysis before generalization.
decision_table.forbidden_inference: A development-case success is not algorithmic novelty or publishability proof.

decision_table.condition: Dependency policy withdraws a conclusion whose independent support remains valid
decision_table.decision: Record over-withdrawal; preserve the independent branch and evaluate explicit support alternatives before broadening the method.
decision_table.forbidden_inference: Loss of one premise does not establish falsehood.

decision_table.condition: All methods fail or disagree because scope, retrieval, extraction or authority is unresolved
decision_table.decision: Resolve or report that upstream issue separately; do not score fabricated annotations as natural end-to-end performance.
decision_table.forbidden_inference: Identical model names do not create matched inputs.

decision_table.condition: Exact solver improves only objective value or annotated support survival
decision_table.decision: No answer-level or search-novelty claim; compare against restarted iterative baselines if a real residual problem remains.
decision_table.forbidden_inference: Objective improvement does not entail useful answers.

excluded_claims: historical authenticity or availability from hashes
method performance from support-adapter unit tests
